transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Honestly, Doctor, I feel absolutely amazing and filled with this incredible, overflowing energy for the past two weeks! I've barely needed any sleep lately but still feel completely refreshed and ready to go. My family insisted I get checked out because they're worried, but I've truly never felt better in my life!

During these past two weeks, have you experienced any periods where your behavior became so impulsive or risky that you required hospitalization, or did you encounter significant problems with your job or legal issues?

I've definitely been a bit impulsive lately, like spending way too much money on shopping sprees and driving much faster than usual. I've also taken on a ton of projects at work which has caused some chaos, but I haven't been hospitalized or faced any legal trouble.
